basis_correction: measured STANDARD only through 2026-11-23; the gate is global. Decision population is now every lane, each reported as a sub-arm. See drafts/ttr-floor-all-lane-basis-20261123.md (approvals apr-profit-floor-ttr-all-lane-basis).

rule.decision: n-driven: flip live unless the at-risk band returns >= +3.0% at n >= 150 settled legs
rule.decision_population: COMBINED (all lanes) -- the population the gate binds
rule.calendar_deadline: none -- the original 14-day clause was unmeetable at 4.29 band openings/day and is retired, not reinterpreted

population_basis: PaperTrade isDemo=0, every botId unless --only-bot, settled (closed|resolved, realizedPnl not null), openedAt >= approval, deduped to one leg per bot|wallet|market|outcome

band_admission_path.note: Admission path is read from DecisionJournal.reasonsJson ('Short-TTR lane: ...'), not inferred from price or size. Both paths are inside the lane window [2, 72]h, so a floor raise is cleared by the rescue on either.

reach.mechanism: short-TTR lane rescue (src/lib/scoring/trade.ts laneRescuesGateFailures) clears a 'resolves in ... < min ...h' skip when ttr in [shortTtrMinHours, shortTtrMaxHours], adverse drift <= shortTtrMaxDrift and copyScore >= shortTtrMinCopyScore
reach.probe_result: 0 of 22464 grid cases change under the live ruleset; controls A/B/C reach 75/15/1115
reach.note: reachable_band_legs counts settled band legs the rescue would NOT clear, i.e. the legs a 2->24h raise would actually block. A band-removal counterfactual over ALL band legs (scripts/profit-tenor.py §S15) is NOT this number -- it prices a block that cannot happen.

dedupe_note: bands/by_lane are the decision basis (one leg per bot|wallet|market|outcome, the basis of the S15 measurement and the 2026-11-21 profit review). bands_undeduped is the pre-2026-11-23 basis and the one the historical calibration reproduces; it is reported so a reader can see what the dedupe moves rather than having to trust it.
